name: Candlewick the Barred Tabby Cat
blurb: Candlewick, a brown tabby with dark side bars that rise and dip like a chart, sits on the garden wall watching every flicker.
look: A normal four-legged brown tabby shorthair with dark vertical bars down her sides and green eyes. She wears nothing.

name: Lamplit the Smoke-Grey Cat
blurb: Lamplit, a smoke-grey shorthair with big round copper eyes, stays up all night under the garden lamp after the other cats sleep.
look: A normal four-legged smoke-grey shorthair with a solid coat, slightly darker at the back, and big round copper eyes. He wears nothing.

name: Pocket the Little Tuxedo Cat
blurb: Pocket, a small, quick tuxedo cat with a white bib and four white paws, naps curled up in the pocket of a coat on the garden bench.
look: A normal four-legged small black-and-white tuxedo cat with a white bib, four white paws and yellow eyes. She wears nothing.
